budget.nodeBudgetMeans: bounds the dependent NODES in data.impact[] — NOT the graph engine's caller rows (summary.traversal.engineCallerRows)

rule.cascade: owner-cascade: a relationship stored against a member of a class is attributed to the whole owner family. The RANGE that implements it widens to the member's whole container, so siblings are folded in too; `cascade.rangeFolded` counts how many rows that accounts for in this answer
rule.noisePolicy: hard-noise symbol names and paths are excluded, as in every other analysis surface
